full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph frames a young woman's face in a dim interior. She occupies the center and looks directly toward the viewer with a wide, concentrated gaze. Her dark hair is swept up and to the side in a soft curled shape. A dark rectangular object, held very close to the face, hides the mouth and lower nose. One hand wraps around its left edge near the bottom center, the fingers softly blurred by shallow focus. The exact purpose of the object is not apparent; it acts visually as a barrier that makes the eyes the central point of contact. Another person's partial profile is visible at the far left, turned away from the camera and merging with the dark background. Behind the central woman, a pale vertical opening or doorway glows softly, with a short bright horizontal mark near its top. The rest of the room recedes into indistinct gray and black shapes. Light falls onto the right side of the woman's forehead, nose bridge, and cheek, while a large deep shadow divides the left half of her face. The two eyes remain visible across this abrupt tonal change. The image has coarse grain, gentle blur, and a slightly fogged old-print quality. A narrow pale strip runs along the bottom edge, suggesting the visible border of a print or reflective surface. The composition is tight and layered: foreground object, central face, peripheral profile, and light opening behind. No readable writing appears. The atmosphere is quiet but watchful, with secrecy created by partial concealment and strong shifts between luminous skin and enclosing darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片把一位年轻女子的脸框在昏暗室内。她位于中央，睁大眼睛、专注地正面望向观者。深色头发向一侧挽起，形成柔软卷曲轮廓。一个贴近面部的深色矩形物件遮住嘴和鼻子下部。一只手从左侧握住它，位于画面下方中央，手指因浅景深略微模糊。物件的确切用途看不出来；在视觉上，它像一道屏障，使双眼成为最直接的接触点。另一人的部分侧脸在最左边可见，背向相机，并渐渐并入深色背景。中央女子身后，一道浅色竖向开口或门口轻轻发亮，靠近顶部有短短一条明亮水平痕迹。室内其余部分退成难辨的灰黑形块。光落在女子右侧的前额、鼻梁和脸颊上，大片深影把面部左半边划开；双眼仍跨过这突变的明暗而可见。照片有粗颗粒、柔和模糊和略带雾气的旧相纸质感。底边延伸着一条窄浅色带，像照片或反射表面的可见边框。构图紧凑且分层：前景物件、中央面部、边缘侧脸，以及身后的发光开口。没有可读字样。气氛安静却警觉，局部遮蔽和发亮皮肤与围合黑暗的强烈转换制造出隐秘感。
style_prompt_en: Old-film monochrome photography builds suspense through extreme close framing, partial concealment, and unequal light across a central face or form. A near-black foreground plane masks the lower center while luminous upper details remain sharply attentive. One side receives soft pale light; the other falls into dense shadow without a neat dividing line. Peripheral silhouettes and a distant vertical glow create layered depth in a mostly indistinct interior. Coarse grain, gentle softness, and slightly fogged highlights give the image a physical print quality. A thin pale edge can ground the bottom of the frame. The mood is intimate, watchful, and quietly mysterious, relying on gaze-like focus and tonal contrast rather than visible action.
style_prompt_zh: 旧胶片单色摄影以极近裁切、局部遮蔽和中央形体两侧不均的受光制造悬念。近黑前景平面遮住下方中心，发亮的上部细节仍显得专注。柔和浅光照到一侧，另一侧则落入密集阴影，没有整齐分界。边缘剪影与远处竖向亮部在大体难辨的室内建立层深。粗颗粒、轻微柔化和略带雾气的亮部让影像有实体相纸质感。一条细浅边可稳定画面底部。气氛亲密、警觉而安静神秘，依赖类似目光的视觉重点和明暗对照，而非可见动作。
theme_en: A woman's eyes above a dark object in a dim monochrome interior
theme_zh: 昏暗黑白室内里，女子从深色物件上方露出双眼
name: Duane Michals
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
